name: Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E)

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2023, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 44.65 percent a year from FY2022 (5.87401e+08) to FY2023 (8.4966e+08), over 1 year
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2023 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2023
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 9.09e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (the shares outstanding on the statement file (sharesOutstanding))
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2023, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 9.09e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (the shares outstanding on the statement file (sharesOutstanding))

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 294.0) to the price on 2026-10-05
